_meta.primary: Weyns and Iftikhar 2016 [13] Table I (failure rate F) + Table II (response time W, pending invocations L)
_meta.derived: mu = M/M/1 inversion of Little's Law (L = W * lambda) and W = 1 / (mu - lambda); W read as ms; mu in 1/s
_meta.convention: eps is per-invocation failure rate as a fraction (Weyns 2015 scale); mu is service rate in 1/s; W in ms; L is pending invocations (count)
_meta.note: MAS_{3} at mu = 150 1/s is the system bottleneck. Baseline TAS uses {AS_{3}, MAS_{4}, DS_{1}} per cstudies.md chapter 7.
